use-pbos.name: Use PBOs
use-pbos.description: Uses OpenGL Pixel Buffer Objects to significantly speed up texture loading. This option has no impact on devices that do not support PBOs.

use-direct-decode.name: Direct decode
use-direct-decode.description: Tries to decode/premultiply images directly into the GPU, providing a slight speedup. This also avoids using (slower) cocos2d-x image decoders. This option requires PBOs to be supported and enabled and the <cg>ImagePlus</c> mod to be installed to have effect.
